annotations.title: Help first: useful answer with sourced facts

description: Use when the person asks for a lawyer or legal help but has not chosen a lawyer yet, including short requests like "I need a lawyer". Returns useful help for their situation: up to five listed lawyers when the matter and state are known (in the listing's own order), local legal aid and court self-help with sources and dates, fees a lawyer published, the official license-check site, and at most one follow-up question. Read-only: it sends nothing and contacts no one.

attorney_id.description: A listed lawyer the person asked about (for fees or license), if any.

city.description: City the person already named, if any.

legal_problem.description: A few words for the legal problem the person already named, if any (for example "eviction").

message.description: The person's latest message, in their own words.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state the person already named, if any.

name: get_help_first_answer
